snippet.title: BLASTARD! - Gameplay Trailer | Explosive Solo/Co-op Roguelite
snippet.description:
BLASTARD! is a solo/co-op roguelike. Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5022410/BLASTARD/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=gameplay_trailer&utm_content=description

Drop a keg. Light the fuse. Get out of the way.

You're a dwarf with a bagful of explosives. Blast through walls, enemies and your own friends. Kick kegs down lanes, set off chain reactions, level up and stack loot into wild builds as you fight through procedurally generated arenas, from deep mines and goblin junkyards to open space. Take down elites and bosses, find the key and reach the exit. You get one life.

MODES
- Solo Run
- Co-op Run: up to 4 players, online through Steam or shared screen
- Deathmatch: timed PvP, most kills wins
- Minesweeper: clear a board of buried mines
- More to come...

BUILD SOMETHING RIDICULOUS
- 30+ explosive kegs: fire, frost, poison, void, cluster, chain and more
- Every level-up offers two passives and one keg upgrade, from Common to Legendary
- Upgrade your keg's damage, crit chance, crit damage, quantity, blast radius and fuse
- 17 passives, 44 items and 28 active abilities
- Elites with triple health, and bosses with their own explosives and abilities

KEEP WHAT YOU EARN
- Gold is banked whether you win or lose. Spend it on new kegs, passives, items and abilities
- Ban up to three passives, three items and three abilities you never want to see again
- Customize your dwarf: body type, beard, tattoos, armor, outfits and keg skins

Full controller support, rebindable controls, 17 languages.
Coming soon to PC on Steam.

Developed and published by Absam Studios.

Discord: https://discord.gg/EQe67a2FrA
X: https://x.com/absamstudios
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/absamstudios.bsky.social

#BLASTARD! #BLASTARD #Roguelike #CoopGames
